$comment: Generated registration-graph metadata. `entries` has one row per stable alias `./components/lr-<tag>.js`, always carrying `tag`. `integrations` lists the published integration-bridge specifiers -- an optional-peer resolver, a lazy document-format registrar -- that install an integration without being any single component's own alias, so they carry no `tag`. For every row, `registers` lists every <lr-*> tag that importing `entry` defines, direct or transitive, at import time or on first use (e.g. lr-table.js also registers lr-empty/lr-pagination/lr-skeleton/lr-spinner); `lazyRegisters` is the subset defined only on first use, through a lazy import (lr-table.js defines lr-pagination and lr-skeleton the first time it pages or shows skeleton rows), so every other `registers` tag is defined once the import settles; `distModule` is that retained published deep specifier, or `entry` when no separate deep route is exported (also equal to `entry` for an integration bridge); `localeKeys` lists every LyraMessageKey the registered tags can reach, from the same reachability analysis generate-default-string-slices.mjs uses for the tree-shakeable locale slices. `integrations`, `distModule`, `lazyRegisters` and `localeKeys` are additive to schema version 1. Run `pnpm run registration-graph` (scripts/generate-registration-graph.mjs) to refresh.
